picks.editorial_note: A $334 million grant to acquire and operate a new supercomputer is one of the largest single AI-infrastructure investments of the year, dramatically expanding national research computing capacity.
picks.title: NCSA Joins the Schmidt Science Computing Network to Expand Advanced Computing for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: UC Berkeley and Berkeley Lab's entry into the same Schmidt Science Computing Network establishes the Berkeley Science AI Platform at NERSC, pairing a major philanthropic investment with a flagship DOE facility to accelerate AI-driven science.
picks.title: UC Berkeley, Berkeley Lab collaboration with Schmidt Science Computing Network will Provide High Performance Computing for Cutting-Edge Research - NERSC: National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center

picks.editorial_note: An AI model designed a bacteriophage used in the first-ever treatment of a patient with an antibiotic-resistant infection, a genuine real-world clinical application of generative AI in medicine.
picks.title: This time, the virus is on the patient’s side. AI helped design it

picks.editorial_note: An independent AI-based imaging technique confirmed the landmark Event Horizon Telescope black hole image in Nature, validating one of astrophysics' most iconic results with machine learning.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: Nvidia's CEO resignation amid a national-security investigation is a shock to the AI industry's leadership and supply chain, with implications far beyond any single company.
picks.title: Nvidia seeks successor after Jensen Huang's exit wobbles AI industry

picks.editorial_note: A $19 million state grant to build an AI-integrated computing cluster for semiconductor research strengthens the link between AI and domestic chip manufacturing capacity.
picks.title: Texas Tech Receives $19 Million Grant to Further Semiconductor Innovation | Texas Tech Now

picks.editorial_note: A new Imperial College London-CNRS joint laboratory applying AI to metabolic disease research exemplifies substantive transatlantic academic partnership with real scientific ambition.
picks.title: Metabolism, AI and global health: Imperial and France's CNRS celebrate launch of joint laboratory

picks.editorial_note: Findings that AI models need far less training data than assumed to predict materials' electronic structures could meaningfully lower the cost and barrier to AI-driven materials discovery.
picks.title: Less Data, Faster Discovery: Researchers Rethink AI’s Role in Developing New Materials

picks.editorial_note: A pointed academic critique of the EU's Cloud and AI Development Act highlights ongoing policy debate over Europe's digital sovereignty and dependence on US AI infrastructure.
picks.title: 'EU plan for cloud and AI falls short on digital autonomy'

picks.editorial_note: A new quantization method addressing the KV cache memory bottleneck in large language models, headed for presentation at NeurIPS, offers a practical efficiency gain for AI inference at scale.
picks.title: Faster data compression through quantization
